description: Finding all my models or profile elsewhere than Civitai is without my consent ! Please don't repost my files. I only used the base models to test these. -- HOW TO USE : 2 types of settings : -- 1 : Turbo Strength : 1 tested Steps : 15 tested Checkpoints : Any Adetailer : your choice Other : Instead of using the Lumina style, I used the Qwen one. CFG : 1 and 2 tested Sampler : EULER Sheduler : SIMPLE or BETA or NORMAL -- 2 : Not so Turbo... at all Use this one if you like waiting more ;) Strength : 1 tested Steps : 40 - 50 tested Checkpoints : Any Adetailer : you choice., Other : Instead of using the Lumina style, I used the Qwen one. CFG : 1 tested Sampler : DPM++ 3M SDE Sheduler : KARRAS -- But due to not enough time, I used Euler in most of my generations for this lora. -- Tested on Base FP8 and Base BF16 models. -- No main trigger word But each effect has its trigger word and description words.
